description: Marked vasogenic edema with the impression of a large right frontal mass. Midline shift to the left. Left lateral ventricular dilatation with periventricular hypoattenuation in keeping with obstructive hydrocephalus and transependymal edema. No bone destruction, erosion or hyperostosis.
